name: content-studio
description: Turn a raw technical idea into coordinated, publish-ready content for LinkedIn, Substack, and Medium — then measure and improve it. Content skills: explore (lock the thesis and master content), write-linkedin, write-substack, write-medium (HTML), refine, design-brief, and distribute. Analytics skills: substack-stats, medium-stats, linkedin-stats, and analyze — a data-backed content-quality + outreach audit that ingests the analytics exports you download from each platform. Content-first: approve before generating posts; if content changes, regenerate every platform. Measure, then loop back.
